SETTINGS.TITLE: Configure {name}
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Stages, automations and inboxes for this pipeline. Changes save as you make them.
SETTINGS.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save. Please try again.

CREATE.LABEL: Create a card on new conversations
CREATE.HINT: Every new conversation becomes a card in the first stage.

ASSIGN_TASK.LABEL: Mirror the assignee
ASSIGN_TASK.HINT: Whoever takes the conversation becomes the card owner.

WIN_ON_RESOLVE.LABEL: Win the card when the conversation is resolved
WIN_ON_RESOLVE.HINT: Resolving the conversation moves the card to the won stage.

SETTINGS.INBOXES_HINT: Only these inboxes feed the pipeline. None selected means all of them.
SETTINGS.DELETE_PIPELINE_HINT: Its cards are deleted with it. Conversations are untouched.
SETTINGS.MEMBERS_HINT_OPEN: With no members, the funnel is visible to the whole team. Adding the first one restricts this board to members only.
SETTINGS.MEMBERS_HINT_RESTRICTED: Only these agents see this board. Round-robin distributes leads among them.
SETTINGS.NO_AGENTS_LEFT: Every agent is already a member
SETTINGS.WIP_LIMIT: Card limit for the column (empty = no limit)
